aboutGame.title: What is Road to Jukai?
paragraphs: Road to Jukai is a first-person psychological horror driving adventure developed by Endflame and published by tinyBuild. Set in the dense, fog-draped forests of Japan, players take on the role of a night-shift taxi driver navigating isolated mountain roads, transporting enigmatic passengers whose intentions and humanity remain uncertain.

Over six suspenseful story nights, you must balance vehicle maintenance, route navigation, and unsettling in-cabin interactions. Every ride forces crucial decisions that reveal supernatural anomalies and uncover the haunting lore behind the legendary Jukai woodland.

items.question: What is Road to Jukai?
items.answer: Road to Jukai is a first-person psychological horror taxi driving adventure developed by Endflame and published by tinyBuild. As a night-shift taxi driver in rural Japan, you transport unsettling passengers through cursed forest routes across six story shifts.

items.question: When is the Road to Jukai release date?
items.answer: Road to Jukai is slated for release in 2027 on PC via Steam, with ongoing public playtest opportunities hosted by tinyBuild and Endflame on the Steam Community.

items.question: What platforms will Road to Jukai be available on?
items.answer: Road to Jukai is primarily announced for PC on Steam. Console releases may be evaluated following the initial launch.

items.question: How does gameplay work in Road to Jukai?
items.answer: Gameplay in Road to Jukai blends authentic vehicle controls with psychological horror survival. Drivers accept passenger requests, navigate winding mountain roads, inspect the rear cabin, and make crucial dialogue decisions to reach sunrise safely.

items.question: Where can I find the official Road to Jukai trailer and updates?
items.answer: You can watch the official Road to Jukai Announcement Trailer on YouTube and follow weekly development updates on the Road to Jukai Steam Community hub.
